stratagems.name: Command Re-roll
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after you make an Advance, Charge, Damage, Hazard, Hit, Save or Wound roll, or a roll for a weapon's number of attacks, for a friendly unit or model.
stratagems.effect: Re-roll that roll. If several dice were rolled together, re-roll one of them — except Charge rolls, which are re-rolled in full.

stratagems.name: Epic Challenge
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after a friendly CHARACTER unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.effect: Select one CHARACTER model in your unit. Until the end of the phase, its melee weapons have [PRECISION].

stratagems.name: Insane Bravery
stratagems.when: Battle-shock step of your Command phase, just before you make a battle-shock roll for a friendly unit.
stratagems.effect: That battle-shock roll is automatically successful.

stratagems.name: Explosives
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged EXPLOSIVES or GRENADES unit that is eligible to shoot and did not Advance this turn.
stratagems.effect: Select one EXPLOSIVES/GRENADES model in your unit, then one unengaged enemy unit within 8" of and visible to it. Roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

stratagems.name: Crushing Impact
stratagems.short: Charging Monster/Vehicle: roll D6s equal to its Toughness
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, just after a friendly MONSTER or VEHICLE unit ends a Charge move.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit and one of your models engaged with it. Roll a number of D6 equal to that model's Toughness: each 1 deals 1 mortal wound to your unit; each 5+ deals 1 mortal wound to the enemy unit (maximum 6 per unit).

stratagems.name: Rapid Ingress
stratagems.short: A Reserves unit makes an ingress move early
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly unit in Strategic Reserves (excluding AIRCRAFT).
stratagems.effect: Your unit makes an ingress move.
stratagems.restrictions: Cannot be used during the first battle round.

stratagems.name: Fire Overwatch
stratagems.short: Snap shoot: one target within 24", hits on 6s only
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged unit (excluding TITANIC units).
stratagems.effect: Your unit shoots using snap shooting: it can target only one visible enemy unit within 24", each attack hits only on an unmodified Hit roll of 6 (these are not Critical Hits) and Hit rolls cannot be re-rolled. Afterwards it cannot start an action until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: Smokescreen
stratagems.short: SMOKE unit grants the Benefit of Cover
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent's Shooting phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, attacks that target your SMOKE unit — or a unit that is not fully visible to the attacker because of models in your SMOKE unit — are made against a target with the Benefit of Cover.

stratagems.name: Heroic Intervention
stratagems.short: Charge in your opponent's Charge phase (+1CP: Into the Fray)
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged unit within 12" of one or more enemy units. A VEHICLE unit can only be selected if it is a CHARACTER or WALKER unit.
stratagems.effect: Resolve a charge with your unit, choosing a mode before the Charge roll. Leap to Defend: its charge targets must be enemy units that made a Charge move this phase and are within the maximum distance. Into the Fray (+1CP): a Charge roll above 6 counts as 6, but any enemy units within 6" of your unit and within the maximum distance can be targeted.

stratagems.name: Counteroffensive
stratagems.short: Your unit gains Fights First and fights next
stratagems.when: Fight step of your opponent's Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has resolved its attacks.
stratagems.target: One friendly unit that is eligible to fight.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has Fights First and must be the next unit you select to fight.
